title: Synthesis of an imine-type nickel complex and investigation of its electrocatalytic activity for H2 evolution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2430-2436
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08116A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lan H. Le, Ngoc H. Pham, Phong D. Tran, Tung H. To
An nickel complex was synthesized by the coordination between in situ generated imine ligand and Ni(II) source, with complete structural characterization. Its electrocatalytic activity for H2 evolution in the organic medium showed positive results.
